verdicts.reason: A keeps the original one-line headline, the stack is centred and there's room around it. However, the SOLSTICE logo has shrunk to an unreadable size, the sun's rays are gone, and the CTA is scaled up so far that it competes with the headline. B breaks the headline over two oversized lines and pushes the CTA almost to the bottom edge, where it spans nearly the full width. That leaves the bottom cramped next to the empty area at the top. B's logo is also tiny and has lost its rays.
